verdict.rationale: LangGraph lets you constrain agent behavior by mixing hand-coded deterministic steps with LLM-driven steps in a predeclared graph. Interrupts can also pause execution for human approval before continuing. These are indirect control mechanisms rather than a documented tool-permission system, and the pack has no evidence of sandboxed execution. missing for 10: a documented fine-grained tool permission/allowlist model, sandboxed code or tool execution, and independent hands-on corroboration of guardrail enforcement.
